parameters.name: index_backend
parameters.description: Backend used to build the retrieval index.

parameters.name: recall_k
parameters.description: Number of documents scored for each query.

parameters.name: query_terms
parameters.description: Seed terms appended to every query.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Weight of the lexical score in the hybrid ranker.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of passages retrieved per query.

parameters.name: router_temperature
parameters.description: Softmax temperature used when routing tokens to experts.

parameters.name: candidate_ids
parameters.description: Explicit passage ids to force into the candidate pool.

parameters.name: rerank_scores
parameters.description: Optional precomputed reranking scores for each candidate.

parameters.name: span_lengths
parameters.description: Allowed subword span lengths for the merge candidate generator.

parameters.name: merge_ratio
parameters.description: Fraction of adjacent subwords merged before decoding.

parameters.name: enable_beam
parameters.description: Whether to keep the beam of partial detokenizations alive.

parameters.name: score_aggregator
parameters.description: Optional callable that rescales partial hypothesis scores.

parameters.name: layer_ids
parameters.description: Encoder layers whose subword units are merged.

parameters.name: prompt_template
parameters.description: Prompt prefix used by the streaming decoder.

parameters.name: target_size
parameters.description: Number of documents retained by the solver.

parameters.name: thresholds
parameters.description: Constraint thresholds applied during filtering.

parameters.name: filter_config
parameters.description: Per-source exclusion rules keyed by source name.

parameters.name: allowed_sources
parameters.description: Sources eligible for the curated corpus.

parameters.name: dedupe_keys
parameters.description: Fields used to detect near-duplicate documents.

parameters.name: rounds
parameters.description: Number of federation rounds to simulate.

parameters.name: client_weights
parameters.description: Optional per-client weights overriding the bandwidth schedule.

parameters.name: aggregator
parameters.description: Optional callable used to rescale incoming updates.

parameters.name: participating_clients
parameters.description: Explicit client ids to include in each round.

parameters.name: optimizer_args
parameters.description: Keyword arguments forwarded to the local optimiser.
